propositions: rebar comment silently accepts flag-looking arguments (--body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, destroying the intended content while exiting 0
a positional body argument beginning with - must be rejected with non-zero exit and usage guidance, unless explicitly escaped with -- before the value
the same positional-body footgun exists in create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, and set-verify-commands and must be guarded uniformly
a body argument that begins with - must be rejected loudly with no silent coercion, truncation, or fallback behavior
escape hatch via -- must allow values that legitimately start with - to be stored correctly
test suite must cover rejection of --body-file <path> and --body <text> specifically, and must verify the guard is load-bearing
